metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1998 · Wild Things
metas.description: A police detective uncovers a conspiracy behind a case involving a high-school guidance counselor when accusations of rape are made against him by two female students.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.5 · 2004 · Wild Things 2
metas.description: Sequel to the hot film Wild Things, Wild Things 2 sees teenage bad girls Maya and Britney go on a sex and killing spree to win millions.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.5 · 2005 · Wild Things: Diamonds in the Rough
metas.description: Two young women will stop at nothing for one to gain a $4 million inheritance of two priceless diamonds, while two detectives try to thwart their plans, but find complications abound.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.4 · 2010 · Wild Things: Foursome
metas.description: A murdered hotel millionaire's son finds himself tangled up in a game of seduction and murder after a raunchy night with three beautiful women.
